# OneStage managed rules

Use `angular-change`, `api-contract-change`, `secure-code-review`, `observability-readiness`, and `pr-readiness` as applicable. Preserve repository-derived Angular and package-manager conventions. Human approval is required for deployment and sensitive operations.

Never commit or push directly to the `main` branch. Create a separate branch and submit every change through a pull request. This is a strict rule.
